observation_semantics.selection_odd: explicit alias of odd for the selected/picked selection
observation_semantics.opposite_odd: odds for the mathematically opposite selection in the same market/bookmaker
observation_semantics.timeline: every persisted observation is retained; repeated identical quote states remain separate snapshot records

production_quote_health.semantics: Target health is exact fixture + bookmaker + market + selection. Missing/stale target data is degraded state, never fabricated data and never a reason to discard unrelated collector observations.

rules.first_seen: earliest valid persisted observation for exact fixture/market/bookmaker/selection
rules.pick: exact Daily Bulletin odds at the production decision timestamp
rules.current: latest valid persisted observation strictly after PICK and before kickoff; ACTIVE/PENDING only
rules.closing: last valid persisted odds observation before kickoff, after the pick; available only after kickoff
rules.clv: Pick odd / Closing odd - 1; null when Pick or Closing is unavailable
